commands.title: Scan For Illegal Pals
commands.description: Lists pals whose level or condensing rank is above the legal maximum. Changes nothing.

params.label: Owner
params.description: Leave as Any to scan every pal in the world.

commands.title: Fix Selected Pals
commands.description: Clamps the level and condensing rank of the selected pals down to the legal maximum.

commands.title: Repair Structures
commands.description: Restores every built structure, chest and resource node in the world to full HP.

commands.title: Scan For Illegal Player Stats
commands.description: Lists players who have spent more points on a stat than the legal maximum. Changes nothing.

commands.title: Fix Selected Player Stats
commands.description: Clamps every over-cap stat of the selected players down to the legal maximum.

commands.title: Fix All Pals
commands.description: Heals every pal in the world, recomputing its HP and restoring its sanity, fullness and health, and gives an ownerless pal the owner of the container holding it. Dimensional storage is not touched.

commands.title: Fix Invalid Pal Skills
commands.description: Removes equipped and mastered skills that a pal's own species cannot learn. A pal whose species does not resolve, or that holds a skill the game data does not list, is left untouched and reported.

commands.title: Repair Items
commands.description: Restores the per-item record for every container slot whose record has gone missing - the equipment, armour and eggs that carry one - so the item survives instead of being dropped the next time its container is written. A stackable item, which has no such record, is never touched. The restored item carries default condition, not its original durability, remaining bullets or passive skills.

commands.title: Fix Inventory Sizes
commands.description: Resizes every player's main inventory to the size their key items entitle them to: 42 slots plus 3 for each inventory expansion, up to four. A resize that would drop an occupied slot is refused and reported.

commands.title: Rebuild Guild Membership
commands.description: Reassigns every pal to the guild that should own it, taken from its owning player's guild or from the base whose worker container holds it. A pal that resolves to neither is reported and left untouched.
